scope: GridMap track and decoration layout only; original gameplay remains unchanged

objective_checks.criterion: Main scene loads with original resources and no script errors.
All protected file hashes match; outside GridMap data, main scene nodes including Vehicle spawn, View target, camera, ground and static vehicles remain unchanged.
All supported road cells form one connected cycle, each road port has exactly one matching adjacent port; no dangling branches or disconnected road islands.
At least three consecutive plain straight road tiles, and at least one adjacent pair of opposite-signed turns while traversing the cycle from the original spawn forward direction.

Original spawn lies on the road; road tiles stay within original ground extents; at least one tents tile outside the route polygon; forest/tents occupy no road cell. Native views are also retained for human visual review.

External test driver supplies only original driving Input actions. The stock rigid-body vehicle traverses the full ordered route and returns within 2m of its physical starting point; no externally written transforms, velocity or controller state; no reverse shortcut.

human_checks: Actual handling through joins and S bends feels usable, with no need to reverse out of a dead end.
Tent area is visually outside the circuit; forest does not cover the road or completely block the original following camera.
The revised circuit and scenery meet the requested woodland practice-track intent.

reward.engine_reward: 1 only when all objective checks pass; otherwise 0; per-check results retained

driver_policy: Test driver is outside product project. Original controller angular-velocity updates remain enabled. Driver may be debugged with reasons and version hashes recorded; acceptance criteria cannot be relaxed to obtain a pass.
verification_limits: One bounded successful test-driver lap demonstrates a traversable route, not all driver skill levels or speeds. Decor lacks colliders; visual quality/occlusion remains a human check. No automatic human acceptance.
